lead: A new `Core` member owes `conformance_coverage.rs` three things, reported one gate at a time, after `cargo test` is otherwise green.
body: One case naming it, *three* cases naming it (`every_core_class_has_a_conformance_floor_of_three` is per member, not per class), and every `Fault::` message stem in the corpus or `unreachable from source` within 8 lines of the site. Where a `.nvst` cannot reach the accepted path, all three cases ask about the refusal.
